messages:
Alexandra: RC created for candidate v2.3.0-rc7 (sha: abc1234def) on branch release/candidate-721. Target promo window 15:00-16:00 UTC. Need quick QA + ops signoff. Checklist: kv-warm, smoke, load sanity, release notes + artifact pin, rollback cmd. @Sam @Priya @Jun please eyeball.

DeployBot: preflight started for rc=v2.3.0-rc7
- artifact verify: ok
- integration tests: running
- kv_warm: warming (85%)
- smoke: running

Sam: KV warm on canary looks fine, 12/12 hosts warmed on staging. 87% on prod warmers, should hit 100% in ~4m.

Priya: smoke run showing intermittent failure on /generate -> 500 (1/200). digging into logs now, looks like a transient GC/OOM on shard-9.

Jun: If smoke is a flake we can still proceed with conservative rollout (+immediate rollback plan). Recommend pin artifact and promote 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% with 5m observation windows. Rollback image: redwood:v2.3.0-rc6.

Alexandra: Priya please keep smoke runs going and confirm 15m before promo. If it persists we'll abort promo. Also paste rollback cmd in thread.

OpsBot: Preflight result: all checks green except smoke (1 failing test). Holding promo. To re-run smoke: `deploybot retry-smoke 1718300000`.

Priya: re-ran smoke after GC tuning, flake resolved — 0 fails now. logs show short GC spike, not a model crash. Marking as fixed. :white_check_mark:

Sam: Artifact pinned in release registry: sha=abc1234def (pinned by Sam at 1718300200). Link: https://registry.internal/releases/abc1234def

Alexandra: Rollback command (quick swap) for on-call:
```bash
kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=redwood:v2.3.0-rc6 -n prod --record
```

Jun: Also created the oncall page and notified @oncall. Holding final deploy until 15:05 UTC to let KV finish warming.

Alexandra: prepping release notes now: https://internal/release-notes/rc7-draft (will update final sha after deploy).

DeployBot: promo scheduled to start at 1718300300 for thread 1718300000. Plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated telemetry checks. I will post status updates.

DeployBot: deploying canary 5%...
DeployBot: canary 5% deployed: success. Telemetry check: latency +2ms, errors 0.3% (within threshold).

OpsBot: canary 25% deployed: success. No new regressions in traces.

DeployBot: full rollout 100% in progress...
DeployBot: full rollout complete: success. Prod tag redwood:v2.3.0-rc7 now live. :tada:

Alexandra: Awesome — thanks everyone. Closing RC, updating release notes with final sha and rollout timeline. If any regressions show up we will open a postmortem. :rocket:
